other_conditions: Applicant must be the legal heir of the deceased primary breadwinner.
Family must be solely dependent on agriculture (agricultural labourers or small and marginal farmers) or have an annual income not exceeding ₹24,000.
Application must be submitted within six months from the date of death of the breadwinner.
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time financial assistance of ₹20,000 to eligible BPL households on the death of the primary breadwinner.
